decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint fits the firm's core pipe and valve fabrication business and costs little to keep listed, and it was promoted from a mention in 2018 to its own page in 2019, so the option is worth keeping open.
The powder-coated public waste bin uses the firm's existing metalworking and coating capabilities, so keeping it costs little, and no evidence since 2019 shows its value has failed to materialize.
The waste bin with ashtray is a low-cost variant of the bin line, and while demand for smoking-related street furniture is uncertain, there is not yet enough negative evidence to abandon it.
The outdoor ashtrays face declining smoking rates, but they share production with the bin line and cost little to keep in the catalogue, so the option stays open until results clearly show low value.
